% Pattern: file/line-ends. A file from Windows ends each line with a CR LF, so
% a blank line is "\r\n\r\n". The test gives the file to source.Open with CR LF
% line ends. Seen in the gold pilot (set E).
% lineends crlf
% want head-1 statement/theorem C
% want head-2 statement/corollary E
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
Some text before.

\noindent{\bf Theorem C.} Every compact space is bounded.\\

\noindent{\bf Corollary E.}

Every closed subset of a compact space is bounded.
\end{document}
